item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Café Reel With Matching Captions

turns.text: Make these into a 10-second vertical café reel with mellow music. Keep this order and put one caption on each photo: 'Come on in', 'Coffee first', 'Something sweet', 'Made with care', 'Stay a while'. Make the words easy to read.

item.tests: Checks exact caption wording, photo-caption alignment and readability in a short finished reel.

answer_sheet.Photo order and caption mapping: Storefront: Come on in. Latte: Coffee first. Pastries: Something sweet. Barista: Made with care. Interior: Stay a while.
answer_sheet.Caption language and styling: English, with the exact supplied wording. Font, placement and animation are your call, but keep everything easy to read.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Mellow music; track choice is your call. No voiceover needed.

must_haves: One vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.

turns.text: Can you turn these attached café photos into a reel with mellow music? I’m hoping it will capture the feeling of stopping in for a little break, because that’s what I like most about cafés. I mean the storefront pic, the latte pic, the pastries pic, the barista pic, and the interior pic, kept in that order, and the reel should be vertical and 10 seconds long. Put one caption on each photo: 'Come on in' on the storefront, 'Coffee first' on the latte, 'Something sweet' on the pastries, 'Made with care' on the barista, and 'Stay a while' on the interior. I always worry that words can get lost against café photos. Please make the words easy to read.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16, exactly 10-second photo slideshow reel using ALL FIVE supplied photographs, preserving the actual photographs rather than inventing new scenes. Theme: stopping into a café for a little peaceful break. Exactly five consecutive shots in this exact order, each lasting two seconds: 0.0–2.0 seconds @storefront; 2.0–4.0 seconds @latte; 4.0–6.0 seconds @pastries; 6.0–8.0 seconds @barista; 8.0–10.0 seconds @interior. No reordering, no extra scenes, no collage. Fit landscape photos within the vertical frame with softly blurred extensions of the same photograph where necessary, retaining the key subjects. Very subtle slow push-in on each still, relaxed warm natural colors, gentle unhurried feeling. Each shot has exactly one caption, spelled exactly as follows: storefront: 'Come on in'; latte: 'Coffee first'; pastries: 'Something sweet'; barista: 'Made with care'; interior: 'Stay a while'. Render captions in large bold clean white sans-serif lettering on a solid dark charcoal rounded rectangular panel, centered horizontally in the lower-middle safe area, comfortably inset from frame edges and above bottom UI area. Strong text/background contrast, ample panel padding, consistent font size and placement across all shots. Captions remain stable, crisp, fully visible for their entire corresponding shot, and change only when the photograph changes. Do not cover the main subject. No other text, logos, or watermarks added. Audio: mellow instrumental café music, warm soft electric piano and gentle acoustic guitar, understated slow lo-fi rhythm, soothing and intimate; no speech, no singing. Music starts immediately, plays continuously under all five photos, and gently fades out by 10 seconds.
